description: This Java source file defines the 'SearchSource' class, which provides a stream-based mechanism for executing search queries over 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages constructing search queries, handling pagination and resumption, retrieving thing data, processing sort fields, and integrating with Akka streams for reactive processing.

classes.name: SearchSource
classes.description: Final class providing a reactive data source for executing search queries over 'things' within the Ditto framework, supporting pagination, sorting, and error recovery.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for configuring a SearchSource instance.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the search source stream, returning a reactive source of JSON objects representing search results.

methods.name: startAsPair
methods.description: Starts the search source stream with resume support, providing pairs of thing IDs and their corresponding JSON objects.

methods.name: mapError
methods.description: Maps errors from stream operations to recoverable states or throws appropriate exceptions.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes the search from the last thing ID, handling pagination and continuation.

methods.name: nextSeed
methods.description: Determines the next seed (starting point) for pagination based on the final elements of a previous batch.

methods.name: streamThingsFrom
methods.description: Creates a stream of 'StreamThings', optionally setting sort values based on the last thing ID.

methods.name: retrieveSortValues
methods.description: Retrieves sort field values for a specific thing to assist with pagination.

methods.name: retrieveThingForElement
methods.description: Retrieves a 'thing' JSON object given its ID, handling access exceptions and syncing issues.

methods.name: retrieveThing
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous request to retrieve a 'thing' object from the cloud, using specified fields.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the Ditto headers used for requests.

methods.name: expectMsgClass
methods.description: A helper method that creates a stream flow expecting a specific message type, handling conversions and failures.
